children: XI'AN, China, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Entrepreneur Universe Bright Group ("EUBG" or the "Company"), a Nevada corporation, reported its unaudited financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. For more information, please refer to the Company's Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on November 16, 2026.
Third Quarter and Nine-Month 2026 Financial Results Summary
Revenue: $680,624 for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $1,217,966 during the same period of 2025.
Net Loss: The Company recorded a net loss of $221,730 for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to net income of $395,113 during the same period of 2025.
Nine-Month Revenue: $2,164,581 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $3,323,026 during the same period of 2025.
Nine-Month Net Loss: The Company recorded a net loss of $178,346 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to net income of $1,001,450 during the same period of 2025.
Cash and cash equivalents were approximately $8.94 million as of September 30, 2026.
Business Overview

EUBG provides digital marketing consultancy services through its indirect wholly-owned PRC subsidiary. The Company focuses on delivering marketing consulting and related services to start-up and small-sized enterprises in China, supporting brand development and e-commerce through online traffic generation and integrated advisory solutions. The Company also conducts commercial lending activities in Hong Kong through its indirect wholly-owned Hong Kong subsidiary.

During the third quarter of 2026, the Company continued to develop its digital marketing services, which generated revenue of $107,080 for the quarter. In addition, HengYing International Investment Limited, the Company's indirect wholly-owned Hong Kong subsidiary, progressively commenced its Credit Services business following the renewal of its Money Lenders License in June 2026. Credit Services generated $7,516 in loan interest income during the quarter from a secured loan of approximately $2.04 million made to a single third-party borrower in September 2026.
Strategic Outlook
EUBG continues to focus on strengthening its consulting capabilities, improving operational efficiency, and enhancing long-term competitiveness.

The Company is also continuing to evaluate and develop strategic expansion opportunities, including selected fintech-related initiatives through its Hong Kong subsidiary, HengYing International Investment Limited.
In addition, on February 25, 2026, the Company effected a 1-for-10 reverse stock split.
Management Commentary
Mr. Guolin Tao, CEO of EUBG, stated:

"Our third quarter results reflected contracting demand in certain consulting service lines, while digital marketing services and our newly established Credit Services segment contributed revenue during the period. We will continue to manage our operations prudently, strengthen our service capabilities and pursue opportunities to expand our revenue base in line with our long-term business objectives."
About Entrepreneur Universe Bright Group

Entrepreneur Universe Bright Group is a Nevada holding company that conducts its operations through its wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong and mainland China. The Company primarily engages in digital marketing consultation services in China and also conducts credit services in Hong Kong.
For more information, please visit: www.eubggroup.com
